title: Cubic class_group_gen assembly leaf
objective: Compose existing Smith and nf_cxlog interfaces into an exact class_group_gen assembly leaf for one authentic cubic fixture, verifying M1/M2 and Ga/Ge/GD/ga/clg2 across dynamic and native tiers

oracles: native GMP and tagged differential replay

handoff.summary: Added a composition-only class_group_gen leaf that consumes the existing exact Smith and totally-real cubic nf_cxlog implementations, then constructs M1, M2, Ga, GD, ga, and the packed clg2 components. A pinned pristine PARI oracle authenticates the nontrivial class-number-24 field x^3-200*x+7 and its actual four-factor genback multiplier across CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged execution.
risks: This leaf begins after generic genback and therefore imports authentic W, C, and Ge from the oracle rather than constructing reduced ideal generators itself.
The first connected fixture is a totally real cubic with one active Smith generator; mixed signatures and arbitrary rational basis coordinates remain outside the nf_cxlog contract.

The broad pnpm test:native gate is intentionally deferred to the converged integration tree to avoid another production-pack rebuild; focused compilation/differential replay and strict baselib validation pass.
next_steps: Connect signed generic genback output to the packed Ge boundary and replay the associated principal-ideal identity.
Feed accepted resident W and cleaned C owners from the full driver instead of the pristine oracle.
Rerun pnpm test:native on the converged integration tree before merge.
